commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 41
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-wur-mirror-qa.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
kaggle datasets download -d piantic/autonomous-greenhouse-challengeagc-2nd-2019 -p "$WORK"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from hashlib import sha256
from zipfile import ZipFile
from io import TextIOWrapper
import csv,json,os
base=Path(os.environ['WORK'])
archives=list(base.glob('*.zip'))
assert len(archives)==1, 'single pinned Kaggle mirror archive expected'
zip_path=archives[0]
print('MIRROR_DOWNLOAD|',zip_path.stat().st_size,'|SHA256|',sha256(zip_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sep='')
with ZipFile(zip_path) as z:
 names=z.namelist()
 print('MIRROR_ARCHIVE_FILE_COUNT|',len(names),sep='')
 for name in names:
  if name.endswith('GreenhouseClimate.csv') or name.endswith('Weather.csv'):
   info=z.getinfo(name)
   if info.file_size>25_000_000:raise ValueError('unexpected oversized single CSV')
   with z.open(name) as raw, TextIOWrapper(raw,encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace',newline='') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    cols=reader.fieldnames or []
    rows=0;first=[];last=[]
    nonempty=Counter()
    for row in reader:
     rows+=1
     if rows<=2:first.append({k:str(row.get(k,''))[:50] for k in cols[:12]})
     last=[{k:str(row.get(k,''))[:50] for k in cols[:8]}]
     for k in cols:
      v=row.get(k)
      if v is not None and v.strip() not in ('','nan','NaN','None','null'):nonempty[k]+=1
    print('WUR_KAGGLE_FILE|'+json.dumps({
     'path':name,'size_uncompressed':info.file_size,'rows':rows,
     'columns_count':len(cols),'columns':cols[:130],
     'first_rows':first,'last_row':last[0] if last else None,
     'nonempty':{k:nonempty[k] for k in cols[:90]}
    },ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('KAGGLE_MIRROR_RAW_SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE')
PY
